title: BedwarsxKanji
description: Bedwarspack themed japanese, with custom guis, blocks, particles, items and more.
body: Hi, this is my second texturepack now. it wa sa lot of work again and I will apreciate your support. The pack contains custom guis, items, blocks, particles,croshair and soon a sky and more sounds. Its themed lika a manga. I used kanjis, wich are japanese or chinese letters. every kanji you will see has its own meaning i thougt of. If there are any issues i will fix them. Actually I pixeld a few animecaracters at differnt spots and some textures were a troll. I hope you dont mind.Thank you verry much and have fun with my pack.
